notes_for_editor: Three sources, and none gives staffing or access. The FFLA legend supports the cab-gone reading. The 1921 Digital Maine item is catalogued as a still image in the Avery Collection (keyword: Map). The word 'panoramic' does not appear on that page, so it was removed from the story and this record. No item-level rights statement appears on the page, so no photo entry was added. The record's 14.6 m matches the 48-foot figure; no correction needed. Brief status note is accurate.
